svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 120 x 215 mm of 3 mm steel. Fold an 18 mm foot at one end, 90 degrees,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: toward the fan side; the upright then stands 197 mm tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Intake hole 112 mm across, centre 137 mm above the underside of the foot,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred across the width. Cut with a hole saw or by chain drilling.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 4.4 mm holes on a 105 mm square round the intake hole, for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot: two 6.5 mm holes, 9 mm from the upright, 40 mm each side of centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the fan's back face sits flat on the upright, held by four M4 x 45

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws and nuts; the fan blows through the shield side onto the mold.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two M6 screws hold the foot to the base plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the fan is 1 mm clear of the shield side; its guard is fitted.
